title: The Vault
subtitle: Where the house pays, in every way it knows
description: The vault is where the house pays out, and the house has an opinion
about every way a payout can work: one claim per team, one the
player picks, one with a bonus rolled on top, one skipped if you
already carry it, one that Claim all leaves for its own press, one
that even a payout block cannot hold, and two that run as commands
-- one loud, one silent, and one that opens the scoreboard the
The first account is the one to read first: its reward is a
scoreboard, which is what the ledger's condition later reads. A
score condition against a missing objective reads as zero, not as
an error -- the objective has to be made by somebody, and this is
